{
  "output_quality": {"score": 4, "reason": "Competent, appealing cartoon drawing of a sloth operating a yellow excavator. All shapes are recognizable, nothing appears blank or clipped. Detailed rendering with gradients and shading gives it visual depth, though nothing stands out as flawless."},
  "instruction_following": {"score": 5, "reason": "Meets every hard requirement: single self-contained SVG, no external assets, valid XML, 1200x800 landscape viewBox, no JavaScript. Includes sky/sun/clouds, dirt pile, cones/rocks/caution stripe, full excavator with tracks/cab/arm/bucket, and the sloth with hard hat and high-vis vest. 48 animation elements far exceed the four-element minimum."},
  "creativity": {"score": 4, "reason": "Charming and original subject: a sleepy sloth in construction gear operating an excavator. The drifting-to-sleep \"Zzz\" floating upward is an inventive touch that fits the brief. Composition and motion remain grounded in the construction-site concept without being generic."},
  "animation_fidelity": {"score": 4, "reason": "Motion genuinely works across the three captured moments: clouds drift to new positions, the sun rotates, the excavator arm/bucket shifts through its digging cycle, and \"Zzz\" appears above the sloth as it falls asleep. Elements animate continuously rather than statically bobbing in place."},
  "richness_detail": {"score": 5, "reason": "Very rich scene: 16 gradients, layered shapes, shading throughout, sky glow, dirt pile texture, traffic cones, rocks, caution stripes, and a detailed excavator with tracks, rollers, cab window, steering wheel, and toothed bucket. Strong sense of depth and complexity."},
  "composition_aesthetics": {"score": 4, "reason": "Well-balanced layout with the excavator centered, dirt pile providing visual weight on the right, and cones framing the foreground. Color harmony is strong (yellow excavator against blue sky and brown earth). Legible and polished, with no clutter or clashing elements."},
  "summary": "A charming, detailed animated SVG of a sloth operating an excavator that satisfies all hard requirements with working multi-element animation and rich visual composition."
}
